newsitem.title: USA: U.S. chain store sales up 0.2 pct -- BTM/Schroders.
newsitem.headline: U.S. chain store sales up 0.2 pct -- BTM/Schroders.

text.p: U.S. chain store sales rose 0.2 percent in the week ended April 19 from the prior week, according to the seasonally adjusted BTM/Schroders weekly chain store sales index.
Sales for the week were up 2.9 percent on a year-over-year basis, while the month-to-date index was off 1.2 percent from the prior month.

"Sales were slightly below plan for most retailers," the report said. "A few retailers noted adverse weather continued to impact the sale of 'warm-weather' merchandise during the early part of the week."
The report, which is normally embargoed for 0900 EDT/1300 GMT, was released early by other news agencies.
